Unlock Free ChatGPT Voice On Mobile App

23 November 2023·Impulse Digital

Introduction

In the rapidly evolving landscape of technology,

“Artificial intelligence has consistently surprised us.” With new transformative innovations and features, AI has opened doors to new possibilities, enabling a futuristic approach. While we talk about various AI-driven advancements, ChatGPT introduced by OpenAI, stands as a foremost application used by many people to make their mundane tasks seemingly easier and quicker.

We have all relied on ChatGPT at some point be it for suggestions, ideas, or learning; while its accuracy may be limited but, it has undoubtedly been of great help to get assistance for creativity and acquiring knowledge on various topics.

Did You Know “ChatGPT has Now Enabled Voice Feature for Free in a Mobile Application”?

Let Me Take You Through the Feature and How To Use It:

Step 1: Download the ChatGPT Mobile Application

Step 2: Setting Up and Understanding Its Features

Step 3: If You Already Have the Application, Update the App to Enable the New Voice Feature.

Step 4: Now you Have to Simply Click on the Headphone Icon to Start Using the Feature.

Step 5: Select From the 5 Provided Options for Voices, You Can Also Change This Later From the Settings.

Step 6: Start Your Conversations Seemingly Easily and Enable the Feature of Voice Conversation Actively.

Note: If the Voice Feature Does Not Work Smoothly, You can Also Give Your Genuine Feedback to ChatGPT.

Use Case

In the use case below, our team member asked ChatGPT

How to choose the right digital marketing agency for my business? ChatGPT replied that you need to consider your specific needs and look for agencies with experience in your niche.

Our Genuine Review About This Feature

Our team members have tried and tested this new feature, and we are quite impressed with its voice features. It has contributed to making AI more simplified leading to the progressive feature being even more convenient for a wide variety of users supported in diverse languages.

Conclusion

This feature was earlier available to ChatGPT’s plus members only, along with other benefits.

Since this voice feature is new it may have a few interruptions and problems. However, the overall feature has proved to be useful and convenient to the users for free now!
